messages:
Olivia: Quick idea 1s: instead of the wide quickstart banner, show a compact 'Sample chooser' in the right rail that expands into the checklist when clicked. Cleaner, less noisy. Thoughts? Kevin: I like decluttering the top. Right-rail gives persistent but low-profile discoverability. Need to ensure mobile/compact breakpoints still show an obvious path. Sam: Accessibility: if the chooser expands inline, focus must move into the expanded panel and announce the new content. Also ensure the panel is keyboard-navigable and has skip links back to main content. Maya: For Dedicated/Private, that rail should swap to 'Upload template' and link to docs. Can't show hosted samples to those customers. Ben: Microcopy: users called it 'templates' in interviews, not samples. Suggest label: 'Start from template' with helper text 'Starter apps and integrations'. We can A/B test 'sample' vs 'template'. Olivia: Figma quick mock: https://figma.com/file/jkl987/rail-sample-chooser 1s: shows collapsed + expanded + mobile fallback. Kevin: We'll add telemetry: which control opened (rail vs banner), which copy clicked. EXP-780 to track. aria-bot: Accessibility scan recommendation: ensure expanded panel has role="dialog" or role="region" with aria-label, use aria-live="polite" for import status, and add visible focus states. Also avoid single-letter shortcuts. Sam: Snippet we can reuse: ```html
``` ux-bot: Research note: in 6 unmoderated sessions PMs used 'starter' language; devs used 'sample' or 'repo'. Recommend copy map for role-aware variants. Olivia: Action items: I'll update mock with ARIA labels and both copy options; Kevin create EXP-780; Sam to add a11y acceptance steps; Maya to spec Private/Dedicated variant. I'll prototype the expand animation for usability testing Thurs. Kevin: I'll also add a mobile fallback (full-width banner) for small screens. Olivia: Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
